★ Request
Fade in / Post-fade in

The girl who introduced herself as K.S. Miracle had desperately
pleaded that she 'wanted to debut no matter what,' but—
Just like—a miracle.

...I understand, I'll tell you everything. But would it be alright
if we moved somewhere else? It's a bit crowded here...
I want to repay the favor.
Fast, faster, purely chasing speed, she ran.

Indeed, just aiming for the Twinkle Series is difficult enough.
Many girls only manage to reach this point thanks to immense support from those around them.
And that leads back to how we arrived at the opening scene, but...

Just as I saw earlier, she clearly has the talent.
If that's the case—!

I was at a loss for words. ...Yet that alone was the entire answer.
There was no way a novice trainer with neither knowledge nor proven skill could simply say yes...

My colleague wore an intensely grim expression. Tazuna-san seemed somewhat concerned as well.
'There's something more to this'... That was the one thing I knew for certain.
No matter what happens, without fail.

Ah... um, I'm sorry to approach you so suddenly.
But I... I really want to debut, no matter what...!
Then, immediately after—

My! Fufufu, you certainly look lively today♪
It's wonderful to see you so full of enthusiasm!
No! Not at all... I'm so happy, really!
Because I couldn't. ...Because my body was too frail.

Her sense of gratitude toward those people must run deeper and stronger than most.
With clear, earnest eyes... she is a sincere girl whom you can't help but want to root for.

If she was willing to work hard alongside me—
...I told her, 'I'd love to form a contract with you.'
! ...Is that so.
Are made entirely of 'thank yous.'

...! Ah... y-yes, absolutely!!
, Trainer...!!

Did something good happen?
Don't tell me... you actually finalized a contract already!

Being scouted is crucial for these girls, so it's only natural she'd be desperate.
Yet precisely because it mattered so much, I wanted us to sit down and talk calmly.

All the things I've been given... the dreams, the hopes, the miracles.
I want to give all of that back by running, and by winning.

It was only a few days after I arrived at Tracen Academy
as a rookie trainer.
Half of my life,
To simply call her 'fast'... felt completely inadequate.

Turf kicks up. The wind roars.
Like a piercing flash of light, like a shooting star tearing through the night.

The Umamusume whose run I had just been watching
suddenly made that plea to me—
...Ah, ...—Excuse me!!

If she was physically frail to begin with, that makes it even worse.
...And on top of that, her drive is 'too strong.'

! .........
...Um, could it be... were you talking to me?

You've heard of it before, right? There are Umamusume whose bodies simply
can't keep up with their top speeds... Their engine is too powerful for the frame to handle.

In hopes of getting a chance to show what she can do, she's also entered
the Disciplinary Track Meet... an academy event where students
can run on courses and distances of their choice.

If you take her on, you'd better have serious resolve and skill.
Leave her to her own devices, and she'll push past her limits
in the worst way possible.

Keep a watchful eye so that doesn't happen, and slam on the brakes no matter what.
...Can you honestly say you're ready to do that?

Her passion for running is just too intense.
Even if she pushes herself into the danger zone... she won't slow down for anything.

She transferred into the Senior Division, which is quite rare here.
And the reason she didn't enroll back in the Junior Division is—

To make it here... so many people supported and saved me.
Truly, countless people.
Her motivation is genuinely extraordinary. However...

K.S. Miracle... Wait, do you mean that frail-looking girl?
...Are you sure about this?

Still riding the high, I confided that tomorrow I'd be making things
official with an Umamusume named K.S. Miracle—a girl endowed with
both immense potential and incredible willpower.

I'm sorry for taking up your time out of the blue...
Thank you so much for listening to me.

It's not that she *can't* stop; she *won't* stop.
Do you really understand how terrifying that is?

Um...! Please!
Would you... be my Trainer?!

I hadn't stopped by the track specifically looking to scout anyone.
As a complete rookie, I just meant to check out the facilities.

Um...! Please!
Would you... be my Trainer?!

K.S. Miracle herself is... a truly wonderful Umamusume.
Even without a contract in sight, she continues to work tirelessly.

I hear she spent practically her whole childhood in a hospital.
...To be blunt, the fact that she's out there running today is a miracle in itself.
—And yet, she's 'too fast.' That girl.

I saw her run in a mock race once...
To be honest, it chilled me to the bone. ...There's a perilous edge to how she runs.
(WHOOSH—!!)

That was why it slipped out completely unprompted.
The awe stirring so deeply in my chest spilled from my lips before I knew it.

*pant, pant, pant...*
*HAHH—!!*

You were asking about K.S. Miracle, correct?
...Well then, to start—

Though we reached an agreement, I didn't have the contract on me...
So we arranged for her to visit the Trainer's office again tomorrow.
